findings.trigger: authenticated=true, checked=true, connectorReady=true; the user returns to the account card and reaches its controls
findings.actual: Sign in / Open, Check account, Check connector, and the enable checkbox remain actionable outside the unrelated global busy state; no explicit Replace/Edit/Upgrade unlock transition exists
findings.expected: A completed account is read-only and only an explicit Replace/Edit/Upgrade action unlocks the relevant operation
findings.smallestFix: Derive verified locked predicates, disable or replace post-success actions, and add one explicit state-owning Replace/Edit/Upgrade transition with state-specific accessible text

findings.trigger: authenticated=false or checked=false or connectorReady=false; the user activates Select on a non-current account
findings.actual: Select is gated only by busy/current state and can mark an incomplete account current while its status facts remain pending
findings.expected: Selection is gated by the mode-specific minimum verified state or becomes Continue setup without changing the current account
findings.smallestFix: Add a mode-aware readiness predicate and provide a setup action or disabled explanation for ineligible accounts

findings.trigger: A keyboard or screen-reader user opens the MCP wizard and moves between its steps
findings.actual: The plain div aria-label 1 / 3 and visual is-active class do not expose a programmatic current step or coherent completed-step state
findings.expected: Assistive technology announces the current, completed, and available wizard steps independently of visual styling
findings.smallestFix: Add stepper grouping/label semantics, aria-current=step on the active button, and an accessible completion state

findings.trigger: A keyboard user opens the expanded MCP guide video and closes it with Escape or Close
findings.actual: Focus is not restored to the expand control and the portal does not contain focus while open, so the user can lose keyboard context in the wizard
findings.expected: Focus enters the dialog, remains contained while open, and returns to the exact launch control on every close path
findings.smallestFix: Retain an expand-button ref, add modal focus containment, and restore that ref after Escape or Close while preserving video time
